# Kbd

A keyboard key or shortcut, shown as text.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Brand expressive</span> Visitors come from social posts on their phones, and they are new customers deciding if they care. A keyboard shortcut serves neither. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./button">Button</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Telling people the shortcut for an action.
- **Not when:** Decoration, or the only way to discover an action.

Instead:

- [Command](./command.md): Where shortcuts are often listed.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add kbd
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

From shadcn/ui. It reads shadcn's variables, which theme.css maps onto this system's semantic tokens, and the radius, shadow and text scale in shadcn.css.
